title: The exposed transfer

branches.condition: Lantern delivers civilian relief without passage protection
branches.consequence: Lose Lantern. If available Grey Petrel is assigned Protect the Navigators, spend its reserve instead and preserve Lantern.

branches.condition: Lantern delivers civilian relief with passage protection
branches.consequence: No crew loss. A funded Protect the Passage order or effective Warrant prevents it; the rescue reserve is not triggered.

branches.condition: Lantern does not deliver civilian relief
branches.consequence: No crew-loss trigger. Funded but halted transport still pays its normal failure consequence and the round’s single transport wear.

public_rules: Lantern must be offered to Navigation and allocated to Deliver Relief. Prepared Beacon 2+ delivers the voyage. Protection prevents the loss; navigator rescue prevents only this specific loss. Protection does not repair Beacon.
